decision: Only Board and Dependency map remain in Work navigation; selected-task control exists only in Dependency map.
implementation_amendment: 2026-10-28 operator instruction supersedes the separate view-switch row in concept images: place Board / Dependency map inline with the active view controls in one desktop toolbar. Proceed to implementation without another concept round.

board.scope: All project tasks matching board filters
board.lifecycle: Read-only placement; no dragging or state updates
board.card_action: Open clicked task by its explicit identity in a centered popup

task_popup.scope: Explicit task identity independent of remembered map selection
task_popup.ticket_action: Replace popup contents with the selected ticket and a Back to task path; no stacked dialogs
task_popup.view_dependencies: Close popup and open Dependency map with this exact task selected
task_popup.close: Restore originating view, scroll and focus

controls: Task selector searching all project tasks
map.node_action: Open that exact ticket in the shared popup
map.graph_filters: Map-only ticket filters; visibly identify hidden tickets/dependencies so filtered graphs do not imply complete context

return_to_board.behavior: Restore board query, filters, column scroll positions and focus. The map's selected task never restricts the board.

entry_rules: An explicit valid map deep link opens its linked project task, before considering remembered selection.
Direct map tab entry reuses last valid map task for that project; if none exists, show Choose a task to view dependencies with the normal task picker.
An invalid or unavailable linked task shows unavailable/reselect state; never silently substitute another.
Map task picker searches all tasks in the current project, independently of board filters.
A task with no tickets retains its context row and Task details, and shows No tickets yet.
Tickets with no edges remain visible as disconnected nodes.
Switching projects clears incompatible selection and scopes remembered view/filter state to each project.
Browser Back follows deliberate navigation; closing a deep-linked popup restores its underlying view; opening/closing must not unexpectedly change task identity.
Protect unsaved content before leaving the popup using existing dialog behavior.

removed_tickets_view.replacement: Tickets remain inside task details and as map nodes, never a top-level Work tab.
removed_tickets_view.entry_points: Update owned links in Home/Attention/Activity alongside removal. Specific ticket links open the owning task's ticket detail directly.
removed_tickets_view.aggregate_ticket_links: Home ticket-count links should open Board with an explicit Contains tickets: <status> filter, distinct from Task status and from column placement; do not reinterpret ticket counts as task counts.
removed_tickets_view.no_compatibility_shims: Remove the old Tickets route branch, navigation registration and owned links together during implementation.

visual_authority: existing UiSegmentedControl, UiDialog, StatusBadge and TicketGraphNode
acceptance: Only Board and Dependency map tabs appear, at the same location across views.
Board has no selected-task dropdown or hidden single-task scope.
Clicked card identity matches popup identity and View dependencies identity.
Task1082 and its six tickets stay consistent across all three concept states.
Switching map task never changes Board filters or scroll restoration.
Ticket list remains reachable without a Tickets tab.
Use existing design tokens/components; static image artifacts are not authoritative measurements.
